description:
Create a new Business Rule in ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus to automate ticket routing. 

Goal: Create a rule named 'Auto-Route Network Issues' that triggers when a new request is created. 

Criteria:
- If the Subject contains 'network' OR 'connectivity' (Match Any)

Actions:
- Set Priority to 'High'
- Set Category to 'Network'
- Set Subcategory to 'Connectivity'
- Set Group to 'Network Support'

Navigate to Admin > Business Rules (under Helpdesk Customizer or Automation) to configure this. Ensure the rule is enabled and saved.
